nom: Peter Thomas Roth Peptide Skinjection Fill + Fix Under-Eye Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry under-eyes, including one who described dry, flaky patches, report the cream noticeably helps.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with a sensitive under-eye area or sensitive skin report no irritation and good tolerance, including one who says it doesn't irritate even with occasional under-eye acne.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their forties through late sixties report brighter, plumper under-eyes and smoother fine lines, though one in her late sixties says it helps her under-eye bags and tear troughs without being a perfect fix.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers report visibly smoother, plumper fine lines and crow's feet, often noticeable within days to a few weeks; a few describe the effect as subtle, with wrinkles still visible though somewhat smoothed, and one felt the 'filling' claim was oversold for actual under-eye hollowness.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the under-eye area as more hydrated, smoother and firmer after use; no reviewer reports it as drying.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer who used to get occasional acne around her under-eye area reports getting it less often since using this cream regularly; this is thin, single-source material.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight texture, layers under makeup without pilling
No white cast, works well on deeper skin tones
Feels too light, wished for a richer texture
Applicator drags product rather than absorbing it
Higher price point than typical eye creams

extraits.titre: I would not buy this product again
extraits.texte: I purchased this in hopes that it would help with my under eye hollowness and puffiness. Other than the cooling sensation of the applicator, unfortunately this does not work. The applicator has a cooling sensation which feels very nice under the eyes, but unfortunately, it does not help to get rid or assist to minimize my issue.

extraits.titre: It's ok, but oversold on the "Fill" portion
extraits.texte: After two weeks of regular use morning and evening, have seen some minimal lightening of dark circles but definitely not filling in. My circles are not particularly sunken. It's a shame, because my spouse has had a great experience with PTR Instant Firm Eye. Appears they've mastered flattening bags but not volume for circles.

I did like this product. I felt like it definitely helped with my dry under eyes. I have really dry under eyes where I get like dry patches and stuff with flaky skin and this definitely helped with it. So I would say it's worth looking into!

extraits.titre: I would definitely buy this product again!
extraits.texte: I like the way the cream applies via the cooling mechanism and it helps to spread the cream evenly. I have a sensitive under eye area and I have had no issues.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. Been using this eye cream for over a month now and I really like it. The applicator is super cool. It kind of serves dual purpose as an applicator and a massager that helps with puffiness. I sometimes will Pat in the eye cream after I use the applicator, but it's not necessarily needed, especially at night. I sometimes will get acne around my under eye area. Since I've started using this eye cream regularly, I don't get it as much. This doesn't irritate my eyes but it does provide ample hydration. I'm not sure how great it is with correcting fine lines, but it definitely provides nourishment to my under eye and crow feet area. I would definitely buy this again.

I am late 60s and have under eye bags/tear troughs. So hard to camouflage! This new product is the best I have found to 'help'. Not perfect, but helpful. I wish there was a tightening product like the Instant FirmX Eye that worked with makeup over it.

Peptide Skinjection™ Fill + Fix Under-Eye Cream is just what my tired eyes needed. I'm 45 and never skip on my eye cream, it's my first step after cleasing. I love the cooling applicator, it feels very soothing. I look forward to using it in my morning routine. I can see some results instantly, my undereyes feel smooth and hydrated. I've noticed over a few weeks that my makeup isn't settling into my fine lines as much, and I don't look so tired. This is my first PETER THOMAS ROTH product, and I'm impressed. I definitely would use this again. I received this for free in exchange for my honest review.

reserve: A number of these reviews are exact duplicates (for example indices 10-12, 24/42/55/56, and 43/63 repeat the same text), which inflates how often certain effects appear, and as with other eye creams, dark circles and puffiness, the most frequently reported benefits, fall outside the concern categories used here.
